components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true

          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type

        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      title: Validation message

      properties:
        message:

          description: The validation message.

## Summary

I implemented the telephone normalization rule for owner creation in this Spring Boot PetClinic REST app.

**The requirement:** On create, strip every non-digit character from the telephone, require exactly 10 digits, store/return the 10-digit value, and reject with 400 when it isn't exactly 10 digits after stripping.

**Two changes:**

1. **`src/main/resources/openapi.yml`** — The `telephone` field's bean-validation pattern was `^[0-9]*$`, which rejects any non-digit input at the DTO boundary *before* normalization could run (so `"(04) 1234-5678"` would 400 prematurely). I relaxed it to `^[0-9 ()+.-]*$` so formatted phone input reaches the controller, and updated the field description. The DTO is generated from this spec at build time.

2. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** (the `POST /api/owners` create handler) — After mapping the request to an `Owner`, it now strips non-digits (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), returns `400 Bad Request` if the result isn't exactly 10 digits, and otherwise stores the normalized 10-digit value before saving.

I put the reject logic in the controller rather than relying on the entity's `@Pattern` constraint, because a persist-time `ConstraintViolationException` isn't handled by `ExceptionControllerAdvice` and would surface as a 500 — only `MethodArgumentNotValidException` maps to 400 there. Normalization is scoped to create, as the spec states.

Both acceptance tests pass: `"(04) 1234-5678"` is stored/returned as `"0412345678"`, and `"12345"` is rejected with 400.
